classification.difficultyReason: Relate path area to outer area minus lawn area, increase both dimensions by twice the path width, then solve the quadratic and select a positive width.

content.prompt:
A rectangular lawn is 18 m long and 12 m broad. The lawn is surrounded by a path of width $x$ m. The area of the path is equal to the area of the lawn. Find $x$.

Introduce a pronumeral, write down a quadratic equation and solve it.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 8, rectangle diagram below the stem
spec.description: An 18 m by 12 m lawn inside a larger rectangle, with a uniform surrounding path. A vertical double-headed arrow spans the lower path width. Decorative lawn fill is omitted under house style.
spec.mathematics: Outer dimensions are 18+2x and 12+2x; the arrow marks one path width x.

answer.worked:
The lawn has area $18\times12=216\text{ m}^2$, so the total area is $432\text{ m}^2$.
$$\begin{align*}(18+2x)(12+2x)&=432\\216+60x+4x^2&=432\\4x^2+60x-216&=0\\x^2+15x-54&=0\\(x+18)(x-3)&=0\\x&=-18\text{ or }3\end{align*}$$
The width must be positive, so $x=3\text{ m}$. Check: $24\times18-216=216\text{ m}^2$.
